H1.sentence: Our retrievers outperform all baseline models across all evaluation metrics.
H1.loc: §4.2 p.5 referring to Table 1 p.3 (the abstract has no numeric comparison)
H1.metric: HIT@5 (share of test queries whose positive document is in the top 5)

H1_alt_cell.sentence: Table 1: Ours (BGE-M3) HIT@5 96.0 vs its backbone BGE-M3 87.7

headline.H2: The framework improves domain understanding and visual-structural retrieval, outperforming larger baselines with significantly less computation (abstract)

notes: The headline sentence is not literally true in Table 1: Ours (BGE-M3) ties ColQwen2.5-3B on MRR@5/@10 and nDCG@5/@10 (87.9/88.2/90.0/90.5 both); it is higher only on HIT@5 (96.0 vs 95.9) and HIT@10 (97.6 vs 97.4). The paper's only test (t-test, p = 0.171) checks run-to-run variation of its own model, not the comparison.
